prompt: Create ONE isolated transparent PNG game sprite: a beautiful small SPIDER SILK COCOON HOME, viewed from the same overhead three-quarter camera as reference 1's game map. Reference 2 supplies the game's chunky dark outlines and restrained ivory sprite palette. Do NOT copy the ugly smooth igloo in reference 1. Design an ORGANIC asymmetrical silk pouch resting low on the ground, an elongated oval cocoon with one tapered knotted end at upper left, a wide torn oval entrance facing down toward viewer in the lower front half. Thick bundled pearly ivory silk wraps diagonally around it in irregular overlapping folds, soft frayed wisps at silhouette, grey taupe recesses and cream highlights. It must clearly read as a spider-made woven silk sack, not a hut, igloo, shell, helmet, bird nest, or perfect dome. Broad dark warm interior opening, spacious enough for TWO small spiders side by side; empty interior, a subtle soft silk bed visible inside. Few tether strands extending out the sides and a couple tiny dried ochre leaves caught in silk. Handcrafted 2D game sprite, matte colors, simplified readable pixel clusters with crisp contour, no photorealism, no 3D, no shiny rendering, no thin scribbles everywhere, no dense microdetail. Width about 1.5 times height, whole silhouette fits with 12% transparent margin. No ground patch, no shadow, no characters, no background, no lettering. Real transparency.
